snippet_primary: "If bank payouts aren't supported in your country, we will pay you via PayPal. You just need an individual or business PayPal account without any restrictions. All PayPal payouts are processed in USD and usually arrive within 1–3 business days. PayPal payouts have a 2% processing fee."
subject_exact: Gumroad Getting Paid help center (help.gumroad.com/article/13-getting-paid, undated, accessed April 2026) states that where bank payouts are not supported Gumroad pays via PayPal; PayPal payouts are processed in USD, arrive within 1-3 business days, and carry a 2% processing fee
metric_value_raw: 2% PayPal processing fee; 1-3 business days delivery; USD only
